_readme: CANONICAL Kanen Coffee repair pricing — single source of truth. Confirmed by Sam 2026-07-31, grounded in 12 months of QuickBooks invoices. When prices change, update THIS file first, then sweep help.kanencoffee.com pages AND kanencoffee.com Shopify pages (repairs, repairs-<brand>, faq, from-youtube, oakland/sf pages) — visible text AND FAQ JSON-LD schema together.

deposits.policy: Non-refundable. Applied toward the final repair bill. Separate from diagnostic charges.
deposits._commercial_note: Published as a $300–$600 range (Sam, 2026-07-31); quoted per job within the range. QB item list price is $600.

most_repairs.basis: QB completed-repair invoices 2025-08..2026-07, n=554, medians rounded down to nearest $50

parts_policy: Online store part prices are intentionally LOWER than in-repair prices. Publish online prices as 'in our online store' (Ulka EX5 $44, BES870XL solenoid $95, Gaggia Classic solenoid $74.95, Silvia Tune-Up Kit $19.99). Parts supplied during an in-shop repair are billed higher (Ulka EX5 $75, BES870XL solenoid $125). Never publish prices for parts not sold in the store.
turnaround: 3–4 weeks (all published turnaround claims; confirmed by Sam 2026-08-01)
